figurative_meaning_en: Non-stop talking; rambling or talking nonsense
example_sentences_in_bangla: এইরে, ক্যাসেট বাজা শুরু হয়েছে, এবার আমি পালাই।
সভায় সে ক্যাসেট বাজার মতো একা কথা বলতে থাকল।
example_sentences_in_english: Oh no, the cassette is playing now, time for me to escape.
In the meeting, he started talking like a cassette player all by himself.
history: This idiom originated in the late 20th century with the popularity of cassette tapes in urban Bengal, referring to the repetitive playback of recorded speech.
note: Reflects the influence of 1980s-90s technology on Bengali colloquial language.
